title: Agent Kannayiram
desc: A private detective, who runs his own agency, solves menial cases with the help of his assistant. However, things take a serious turn when a father wants him to investigate his daughter's murder.

title: Papanasam
desc: Suyambulingam, a school drop-out but an intelligent man, acquires knowledge by watching movies. When a dark incident seems to ruin his family, he uses all his wits to protect them.

title: Anniyan
desc: Ramanujam, who suffers from multiple personality disorder, works as a lawyer by day and a vigilante at night. He uses tips from the 'Garuda Purana' as his tools to expose various antisocial elements.

title: Dheena
desc: Dheena is the adopted brother of a local gangster, Aathi, and together they rule over a town. However, their relationship turns sour because of a misunderstanding between them.

title: Ponniyin Selvan: I
desc: On the orders of crown prince and his friend Aditha Karikalan, Vallavaraiyan Vandiyadevan embarks on a mission to deliver a message where he discovers several conspiracies against the throne.
